description: This is the main activity class for an Android sample app demonstrating animations. It defines a launchpad activity with a list of sample animations, each linked to a different activity class, and handles user interactions to start the selected activity.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity that displays a list of animation samples and launches corresponding activities upon selection.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Inner class representing an individual sample with a title and associated activity class.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, populates the list of samples, and sets the adapter.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to start the selected animation sample activity.
